## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck:strict`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Release considerations

- [ ] No secrets, keys, or sensitive data are included.
- [ ] Required deployment configuration has been updated or is not affected.
